Title: Public Preview: Unlock Client-Side Configuration at Scale with Azure App Configuration and Azure Front Door

Body.Content:
You can now deliver dynamic configuration directly to client-side applications—securely and at CDN scale—thanks to Azure App Configuration’s integration with Azure Front Door. This delivers new flexibility for modern apps and unlocks a critical capability for AI-powered and agentic client applications. 

This means you can now power modern client experiences across:

  • Single Page Applications (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, and others using JavaScript)
  • Mobile/ and desktop applications with .Net MAUI
  • JavaScript-powered UI components or embedded widgets running in browser
  • Any browser-based application that can run JavaScript

Key Benefits:

  • Instant updates without redeploying: Change feature flags and settings centrally; updates flow to browsers and mobile apps in real time. 
  • CDN-accelerated delivery: Azure Front Door ensures low-latency configuration fetches for thousands or millions of clients globally. 
  • Secure by design: No secrets shipped to clients; only scoped configuration values exposed via managed identity. 
  • Simplified architecture: Avoid custom proxy layers—use a built-in, scalable solution. 
Learn more.
